policy_name: Meridian Valley Health Plan MVP-SP-07: Lumbar Spinal Fusion (illustrative)

criteria.criterion: Criterion 1 - Instability: 4 mm or more translation OR 10 degrees or more of angular motion on flexion-extension films
criteria.evidence: Translation is 3.5 mm (below 4 mm), but angular motion is 11 degrees, which meets the alternative threshold.

citation.excerpt: Sagittal angulation change at L4-5: 11 degrees between flexion and extension.

criteria.action_needed: Quote the angulation finding and the policy's 'OR' language.

criteria.criterion: Criterion 2 - Neurogenic claudication or radiculopathy with ODI of 40% or more for 3+ months
criteria.evidence: 14 months of neurogenic claudication; ODI 48%; walking tolerance about 1 block.

citation.excerpt: 14 months of bilateral buttock and leg pain with standing and walking... ODI 48%.

criteria.criterion: Criterion 3 - 3+ months of conservative care, including PT plus medications or injections
criteria.evidence: 18 PT visits over 9 weeks, NSAIDs, gabapentin and 2 ESIs over more than 6 months.

citation.excerpt: 18 visits over 9 weeks... Discharged to HEP; plateaued.

criteria.criterion: Criterion 4 - MRI/CT showing stenosis at the operative level
criteria.evidence: MRI shows severe central and moderate bilateral foraminal stenosis at L4-5.

citation.excerpt: Severe central canal stenosis and moderate bilateral foraminal stenosis at L4-5.

criteria.criterion: Criterion 5 - 6+ weeks nicotine abstinence confirmed by a negative cotinine test
criteria.evidence: The patient reports quitting on {{QUIT}} (more than 6 weeks ago); the cotinine test was ordered at the consult but the result was pending.

citation.excerpt: Cotinine level ordered today - RESULT PENDING at the time of this note.

criteria.action_needed: Obtain and attach the cotinine result. Do not file without it.

overall_assessment: Criterion 1 was misapplied by the reviewer and is met on angulation (11 degrees). Criteria 2-4 are met. The appeal stands or falls on a negative cotinine result for Criterion 5.
documents_to_attach: PT discharge summary and ESI notes
gaps: The cotinine result is not in the record.
Translation alone (3.5 mm) does not meet the threshold.
